decision: Cory selected bounded completion: verified capabilities and explicit UNKNOWN source/canon/gameplay gaps constitute repository construction acceptance; this modifies the original strict checklist interpretation.

gates.scope_limitation: Two foreign-border Scryfall variants remain provisional and have no independently corroborated Wizards source.
Thirteen curated, foreign, starter or special codes stay individually pending; no new official product evidence is inferred.
Eleven older boxed and regional products remain source-pending and never automatically become premier sets.
Pack A has a sourced claims/relationship/card dossier; Elder Dragon genealogy, faction breadth and chronology remain incomplete.
Seven genealogy disputes carry conservative owner dispositions; unresolved canon is not invented and pilot cards stay proposals.
Pack B cited Thran, Yawgmoth, Old Phyrexia and Brothers' War dossier remains a bounded historical slice.
Pack C cited Weatherlight, Legacy and invasions dossier is bounded; unextracted novels/side stories remain explicit.
All three pack dossiers and an acyclic strictly sourced partial chronology are published; unresolved cross-source pairs remain UNKNOWN.
Cited Mending and Gatewatch strands exist; no exhaustive planeswalker biography or total chronology is asserted.
Bolas and War of the Spark graph/story evidence is queryable; extraction of every event/card is not claimed.
Phyrexian and March of the Machine source arcs are represented without assuming every side-story consequence is ingested.
Eight verified legacy bridges allow conservative navigation; undated or unbridged cross-plane history is UNKNOWN.
Three unchanged unapproved pilots have four Oracle-proven roles, staged plans and dated mana curves; matchup power is untested.
100-card/singleton/color/snapshot legality, printing and source-aware rules infrastructure is ready; live brackets, combos and rebuilt lists await later review.

not_certified: Missing individual Wizards primary sources for foreign border, draft/starter and boxed/region-specific historical products
A single canonical resolution for six disputed Elder Dragon genealogy matters
Complete in-universe calendars and a total order across unbridged plane/story events
Exhaustive every-article/every-card lore biographies or complete side-story consequences
Empirically established Commander power/matchups, current unindexed interactions and brackets
Any rebuilt final pilot list or individual owner pilot approval, deferred until after repository construction
Perpetual completion of new-source/Oracle/rules monitoring and future-set ingestion
